This '''warehouse''' was a storage facility that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[New Nystao]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Arthen Brutt]] rented the warehouse and stored in it a number of artifacts that he had recovered from [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]], a former storehouse of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. In about [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the rogue [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dal Konur]] broke into the warehouse and stole a number of items of weaponry, including a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and some [[Droideka/Legends|Droideka]] [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]].<ref name="Rebel Jedi" />
